payload.title: Caducus: subscriptions scoped by site and language for admin-class kinds
payload.description: Caducus 0.2.0 delivers admin-class kinds to nobody (routing.py:228-234) and only operator-class kinds to the SSM operator list. Add subscriptions with a scope (for example language:es) from Caducus's preferences milestone (docs/notifications-plan.md M3), so Papyrus can deliver translation.published to the people subscribed to that site and language. Coordinate in the Caducus repository; Papyrus pins the released version. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450).
